workflow.title: How BaktiNusantara Works
workflow.subtitle: An integrated end-to-end journey from village aspirations to measurable community impact.

steps.title: Villages Submit Real Needs
steps.desc: Village governments & citizens register grassroots challenges and local potentials through verified aspiration forms.

steps.title: Students Discover Posts
steps.desc: Students search matching service posts with smart filters based on academic major, skills, and target region.

steps.title: Team Proposal Submission
steps.desc: Student teams submit structured action plans, work programs, and task allocations online.

steps.title: Validation & Coordination
steps.desc: Village Heads and Academic Supervisors (DPL) validate team readiness and expected project outputs.

steps.title: Execution & GPS Logbooks
steps.desc: Students record daily GPS-verified activity logbooks with periodic supervisory monitoring.

steps.title: Documentation & Lasting Impact
steps.desc: Official Handover Minutes (BAST) with QR Code verification and public portfolio showcase.

roles.title: One Platform, Three Ecosystem Roles

dpl.desc: Manage, validate, and monitor all service activities in one transparent system with automated reporting and digital BAST certification.
